variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: every tile, chart and the table hold a Skeleton, and Needs attention shows three placeholder rows.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No security rules set up yet: the tiles read as dashes, and one bordered EmptyState names the reason and offers Add rule set instead of a grid of empty charts.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The request for the period failed: the tiles read as dashes, and every card keeps its header with a danger Alert that names what did not load and offers Retry.

variants.name: ByActor
variants.summary: Request activity per actor: a Time range Select and a Refresh IconButton in the header over a FilterMenu (actor, outcome, category) with its chips and a destination Input; seven outcome StatTiles (requests, allowed, blocked, held, approved, denied, over budget), outcomes over time as stacked bars in status colors, three BarList breakdowns (actor, category, destination) and a request log DataTable with an outcome Tag, a SeverityTag and the rule that decided each request. A filter that matches nothing shows Clear filters.
